name: Message Function 6 Code
definition: Identifies the type of process related to the message. It partially correspond to the message type identifier (MTI) of ISO 8583.

RCAV.name: Acquirer Reconciliation Advice
RCAV.definition: Advice of transaction totals from an acquirer.

RCAN.name: Acquirer Reconciliation Notification
RCAN.definition: Notification of transaction totals from an acquirer.

RCAQ.name: Acquirer Reconciliation Request
RCAQ.definition: Request of transaction totals exchange from an acquirer.

REJA.name: Acquirer Reject
REJA.definition: Reject of a message by an acquirer.

REVV.name: Acquirer Reversal Advice
REVV.definition: Reversal advice of an authorisation or a financial message.

REVN.name: Acquirer Reversal Notification
REVN.definition: Reversal notification of an authorisation or a financial message.

REVQ.name: Acquirer Reversal Request
REVQ.definition: Reversal request of an authorisation or a financial message.

RCPV.name: Agent Reconciliation Advice
RCPV.definition: Advice of transaction totals from a processor.

RCPN.name: Agent Reconciliation Notification
RCPN.definition: Notification of transaction totals from a processor.

RCPQ.name: Agent Reconciliation Request
RCPQ.definition: Request of transaction totals exchange from a processor.

REJP.name: Agent Reject
REJP.definition: Reject of a message by an agent.

AUTV.name: Authorisation Advice
AUTV.definition: Initiator of the message advises the recipient about the result of an authorisation already performed.

AUTQ.name: Authorisation Request
AUTQ.definition: The initiator requests an authorisation without financial impact to complete the transaction.

AUTP.name: Authorisation Response
AUTP.definition: Response for authorisation without financial capture.

FNCV.name: Financial Advice
FNCV.definition: Initiator of the message advises the receptor that an authorisation has been successfully delivered or completed with a final amount, and requests the clearing of the transaction.

FNCN.name: Financial Notification
FNCN.definition: Initiator requests the clearing of the transaction.

FNCQ.name: Financial Request
FNCQ.definition: Initiator of the message requests both the authorisation and the clearing of the transaction.

RCIV.name: Issuer Reconciliation Advice
RCIV.definition: Advice of transaction totals from an issuer.

RCIN.name: Issuer Reconciliation Notification
RCIN.definition: Notification of transaction totals from an issuer.

RCIQ.name: Issuer Reconciliation Request
RCIQ.definition: Request of transaction totals exchange from an issuer.

REJI.name: Issuer Reject
REJI.definition: Reject of a message by an issuer.

KEYV.name: Key Exchange Advice
KEYV.definition: Advise of a performed key update.

MGTV.name: Network Management Advice
MGTV.definition: Advise of a performed network management service.

MGTQ.name: Network Management Request
MGTQ.definition: Request of a network management service.
